Reviewer: approve only if real run/security logs support success. If structure/security integration is incomplete, return fix_instruction.

files_to_create.description: Project structure scanner with fingerprint tracking

functions.name: generate_or_update_structure
functions.description: Scans project root recursively, ignores junk folders, builds markdown tree, computes fingerprint (e.g., SHA256 of sorted file list + sizes + mtimes), writes PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md and structure_meta.json only if fingerprint changed. Returns dict with keys: updated (bool), fingerprint (str), file_count (int), structure_text (str).

functions.name: get_structure_text
functions.description: Reads existing PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md if present and fingerprint matches current state; otherwise calls generate_or_update_structure and returns the structure text.

functions.name: _compute_fingerprint
functions.description: Internal helper: computes stable hash from sorted list of {path, size, mtime}.

functions.name: _build_tree_text
functions.description: Internal helper: builds readable markdown tree from scanned entries.

functions.name: find_dangerous_code
functions.description: Returns list of matched dangerous patterns (strings). Patterns to detect (case-insensitive, regex): os\.remove, os\.unlink, shutil\.rmtree, Path\.unlink, os\.system, subprocess\.run.*shell\s*=\s*True, rm\s+-rf, Remove-Item\s+-Recurse, del\s+/s, shutil\.move.*\.\./, os\.rename.*\.\./. Must not false-positive on comments or strings that are clearly documentation.

functions.name: is_safe
functions.description: Convenience wrapper: returns True if find_dangerous_code returns empty list.

files_to_create.description: Agent reasoning/thought logger (new file, not changelog_engine)

functions.name: log_reasoning
functions.signature: log_reasoning(agent_role: str, step: str, reasoning_data: dict, project_root: str) -> None
functions.description: Appends a reasoning record to status/last_thoughts.md (create dir if needed). Record format: timestamp, agent_role, step, and relevant fields: for Researcher -> analysis, plan; for Editor -> why, changes_summary; for Reviewer -> verdict, root_cause, fix_instruction, reasoning_summary. Also maintains a JSONL file status/reasoning_log.jsonl for machine parsing.

functions.name: get_recent_thoughts
functions.description: Reads last N entries from reasoning_log.jsonl for context injection.

At start of each run: call generate_or_update_structure(project_path) and store structure_text. Pass structure_text into Researcher and Editor prompts/context.

After each agent completes, call log_reasoning with appropriate reasoning_data extracted from agent output (analysis/plan, why, verdict/root_cause/fix_instruction/reasoning_summary).
